DML.SELECT: SELECT element_type_id as "elementTypeId", element_type_param_id as "elementTypeParamId", param_type_id as "paramTypeId", element_id as "elementId", xAddress as "xAddress", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.modbus_element_element_type_params WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.modbus_element_element_type_params (element_type_id, element_type_param_id, param_type_id element_id, xAddress, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:elementTypeId , :elementTypeParamId , :paramTypeId , :xAddress , :enabled , :visible , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.modbus_element_element_type_params WHERE element_type_id = :elementTypeId AND element_type_param_id = :elementTypeParamId AND param_type_id = :paramTypeId AND element_id = :elementId
